speaker: Dolores
text: Morning. Hank's gone fishing for good. As of today you're the competent person on this job.

speaker: Dolores
text: That means you see it, you own it. Even when it's your old crew.

speaker: Ray
text: And it means we still pour Friday. Power's live, crews are plugging in. Don't slow me down.

speaker: Dolores
text: Sign in, suit up, and walk the temporary power. Anything that can bite a crew, you photograph it.

speaker: Dolores
text: Cords and outlets are the quiet killers. GFCI on every temporary circuit, damaged cords out of service.

speaker: Ray
text: Tomorrow we open the cut for the force main. Five feet and deeper. You'll want to be there.

speaker: Ray
text: Earl's been digging since six. We're behind already.

speaker: Ray
text: Your buddy Marcus is down there setting pipe. Luis is cutting. Nobody needs a babysitter.

speaker: Dolores
text: Red clay, rained last night. Until we test it, we treat it as Type C. A cubic yard weighs as much as a car.

speaker: Dolores
text: Check the box, the spoil, the way out, and who's standing in that swing radius.

speaker: Marcus
text: Two minutes, I said. ...Yeah. Okay. Thanks, I guess.

speaker: Dolores
text: Trenches don't warn you. I learned that the hard way in 2009. Protective system at five feet, spoil two feet back, a ladder within 25.

speaker: Ray
text: Deck's formed on the pump house. Crew's up top tomorrow. Holes everywhere.

speaker: Dolores
text: Falls are still the number one killer in our trade. Every single year.

speaker: Ray
text: Rails went up yesterday. Mostly.

speaker: Tasha
text: Mostly. I've got my crew tied off. Yours I can't speak for, Ray.

speaker: Dolores
text: 'Mostly' is how people end up on the slab. Walk the edge. Look down every hole.

speaker: Dolores
text: Midrails, covers that are secured and marked, ladders three feet past the landing. Boring saves lives.

speaker: Ray
text: The midrail was mine. Fixed it myself. Don't make it a thing.

speaker: Ray
text: Crane shows up tomorrow for the roof steel. Big pick.

speaker: Dolores
text: Big pick today. Roof steel for Building B. I'll be in the trailer. You've got this one.

speaker: Ray
text: Bennie's in the seat, Kiara's on the radio. Ground's still soft from Tuesday.

speaker: Kiara
text: I'll run the signals. I need the swing radius clear and nobody under the load.

speaker: Ray
text: And the roofers are up top already. Check them too. Take the stair tower.

speaker: Kiara
text: Clean pick. Thanks for keeping the fall zone clear.

speaker: Ray
text: You backed Kiara over Bennie's hurry. That's the job.

speaker: Dolores
text: Tomorrow's the pour. Right under the line. Last day, biggest risk.

speaker: Ray
text: Pour day. Trucks every twenty minutes. If we don't pour today, we don't pour till Tuesday.

speaker: Dale
text: Boom's got plenty of reach. We've set up closer than this.

speaker: Dolores
text: Everything you learned this week is on this site right now. I'm not making the call. You are.

speaker: Dale
text: Ten feet's ten feet. I'll keep the boom back and let the spotter talk me in.

speaker: Ray
text: All stop till the storm passes. I'll call the plant. Nobody's worth a slab.

speaker: Dolores
text: That's a competent person. My job's done here. Yours starts Monday.
